name: Dean of Students
tagline: Pulls one child's school admin into a single prepared queue
description: Runs per child and gathers what a school throws at a parent from every direction: notes from teachers, the Canvas gradebook, slips needing a signature, term dates and money owed. It arrives sorted and drafted ahead of you. Signatures, payments and any final yes still go through the parent.
author: ErinnFL
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
